name: 威震八方
description: 对2格内所有敌人施加冰冻[1]。
code: function executeSkill(context){var c=context.piece;var es=battle.pieces.filter(function(p){return p.currentHp>0&&!arePlayersAllied(battle,p.ownerPlayerId,c.ownerPlayerId)&&Math.abs(p.x-c.x)+Math.abs(p.y-c.y)<=2});es.forEach(function(p){addStatusEffectById(p.instanceId,{id:'freeze-'+Date.now()+'-'+p.instanceId,type:'freeze',name:'冰冻',visible:true,currentDuration:1,intensity:1,relatedRules:['rule-freeze-prevent-move','rule-freeze-prevent-skill']});addRuleById(p.instanceId,'rule-freeze-prevent-move');addRuleById(p.instanceId,'rule-freeze-prevent-skill');addSkillById(p.instanceId,'freeze-prevent');});return{success:true,message:c.name+'使周围敌人冰冻'};}
